page_title: WOL 1-0 UNI | Wolfsburg v Union Berlin 23/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Substitution. Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg) on for Ridle Baku.
90+3' The attendance is 25000.
90+2' Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin) has tested the patience of referee Tobias Stieler and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' Union Berlin have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
87' Union Berlin have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
86' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Union Berlin.
82' That will be all from Rani Khedira who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin).
79' Ralph Hasenhuttl has decided to substitute Bence Dardai and he is replaced by Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg).
79' It's time for a substitution. Salih Ozcan (Wolfsburg) comes on in place of Mohamed Amoura.
79' Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards wide of the left post.
75' The resulting set piece from Union Berlin is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

74' The ball is crossed into the box and Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the top right corner, but Kamil Grabara gets a glove on it to thwart him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Union Berlin.
71' 1 - 0 Goal! Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 1:0.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) will replace Janik Haberer.
70' Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) takes a shot from the free kick on the edge of the box and the ball sails inches wide of the right post. What a chance!
67' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is about to take a corner kick.
65' Wolfsburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
63' Ralph Hasenhuttl prepares a substitution. Patrick Wimmer is replaced by Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg).
62' Ralph Hasenhuttl decides to make a substitution. Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) will be replaced by Lukas Nmecha.
62' The game is interrupted as Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) is flagged offside.
61' Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) pounces on a bouncing ball on the edge of the box, but sends his volley well wide of the left post.

59' Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) has a good chance to score with a mid-range attempt after collecting a pass. He aims for the right side of the goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Kamil Grabara.
54' An accurate cross finds its way to Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) who sends in a bullet header towards the middle of the target from just outside the box, but the goalkeeper makes the save.
52' The Wolfsburg players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
46' Bo Svensson has made a change at the break. Tom Rothe has come on in place of Robert Skov (Union Berlin).
46' Bo Svensson makes a switch. Benedict Hollerbach is coming on in place of Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) at the start of the second period.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
45+1' Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Wolfsburg.

43' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes behind for a corner. Wolfsburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
40' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Wolfsburg comes to nothing.
38' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.
34' The corner is swung in but Wolfsburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
33' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Frederik Ronnow. Wolfsburg will take a corner kick.
31' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
28' Union Berlin keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
24' Wolfsburg earn a corner.
15' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tobias Stieler had an easy-decision to make.
11' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) latches on to an accurate cross on the edge of the penalty box and sends the ball towards goal, but it's too easy for the keeper.
9' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) is coming onto the pitch as Diogo Leite cannot continue after picking up an injury.
8' Looks like Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
7' Substitution. Tiago Tomas makes his way off the pitch and Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg) comes on as his replacement.
7' A corner kick by Union Berlin is thwarted by the well prepared Kamil Grabara (Wolfsburg).

7' Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin) latches onto a cross into the box from the wing and gets in a header. It went well towards the goal, but it was blocked by one of the defenders. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Union Berlin.
6' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Tobias Stieler blows for a foul.
5' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
4' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) will deliver the corner kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Wolfsburg will have the kick-off.
Tobias Stieler is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
